verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows 1Password generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. Watchtower flags breaches, weak passwords and duplicates, but it is not described as AI-generated, so it is only an adjacent feature. The MCP servers and AI-readable docs serve external agents and documentation, not in-product AI analysis of user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
